returns._0: owner is the current owner of the Notional system
returns._1: pendingOwner can claim ownership from the owner

params.currencyId: refers to the currency of the reserve

getAccount(address).notice: Returns all account details in a single view

getAccountBalance(uint16,address).notice: Returns account balances for a given currency

getActiveMarkets(uint16).notice: Returns all currently active markets for a currency

getActiveMarketsAtBlockTime(uint16,uint3.notice: Returns all active markets for a currency at the specified block time, useful for looking at historical markets

getAssetsBitmap(address,uint16).notice: Returns the assets bitmap for an account

getBalanceOfPrimeCash(uint16,address).notice: Returns the balance of figure for prime cash for the prime cash proxy, the logic is slightly modified for the nToken account because it needs to return the sum of all cash held in markets.

getCashGroup(uint16).notice: Returns cash group settings for a currency

getCashGroupAndAssetRate(uint16).notice: Returns the cash group along with the asset rate for convenience.

getCurrency(uint16).notice: Returns the asset token and underlying token related to a given currency id. If underlying token is not set then will return the zero address

getCurrencyAndRates(uint16).notice: Returns a currency and its corresponding asset rate and ETH exchange rates. Note that this does not recalculate cToken interest rates, it only retrieves the latest stored rate.

getCurrencyId(address).notice: Returns a currency id, a zero means that it is not listed.

getDepositParameters(uint16).notice: Returns nToken deposit parameters for a given currency

getFreeCollateral(address).notice: Returns free collateral of an account along with an array of the individual net available asset cash amounts

getInitializationParameters(uint16).notice: Returns market initialization parameters for a given currency

getLibInfo().notice: Get a list of deployed library addresses (sorted by library name)

getMaxCurrencyId().notice: Returns the current maximum currency id

getNoteToken().notice: Returns address of the NOTE token

getOwnershipStatus().notice: Returns current ownership status of the contract

getRateStorage(uint16).notice: Returns the ETH and Asset rates for a currency as stored, useful for viewing how they are configured

getReserveBalance(uint16).notice: Returns the current reserve balance for a currency

getReserveBuffer(uint16).notice: Returns the current reserve buffer for a currency

getSettlementRate(uint16,uint40).notice: Returns the asset settlement rate for a given maturity

getTreasuryManager().notice: Returns the current treasury manager contract

getfCashNotional(address,uint16,uint256).notice: Returns the fCash amount at the specified maturity for a bitmapped portfolio

nTokenAddress(uint16).notice: Returns nToken address for a given currency

pCashAddress(uint16).notice: Returns pCash address for a given currency
